FAQ_CARD_DESC: Answers to the most common questions
CONTACT_DESC: Talk directly to our team on WhatsApp:
WHATSAPP_MESSAGE: Hello! I'd like to ask a question about the system.
FAQ_1_Q: How do I register my WhatsApp number?
FAQ_1_A: Go to the Settings page in the sidebar and click on the "Integration" section. There you'll find the field to enter and verify your WhatsApp number. Once registered, you can log transactions and receive reminders directly through the app.
FAQ_2_Q: How do I log a transaction via WhatsApp?
FAQ_2_A: After registering your number, just send a message to our bot describing the transaction. For example: "spent $50 at the grocery store" or "received $1500 salary". The system will automatically identify the amount, category, and type (income or expense).
FAQ_3_Q: How do I cancel my subscription?
FAQ_3_A: To cancel your subscription, go to Settings > Subscription and click "Customer portal". You'll be redirected to the secure Stripe portal, where you can cancel or change your plan at any time. Access remains active until the end of the already paid period.
FAQ_4_Q: How do I create a financial goal?
FAQ_4_A: Go to the "Goals" page in the sidebar and click "New goal". Set the name, target amount, deadline, and category. The system will automatically track your progress based on your transactions.
FAQ_5_Q: How do I create a reminder?
FAQ_5_A: Go to the "Reminders" page in the sidebar and click "New reminder". You can set recurring reminders (daily, weekly, monthly) and will receive a WhatsApp notification at the configured time.
FAQ_6_Q: What number should I use to ask questions or report issues?
FAQ_6_A: Contact our support team directly via WhatsApp: +55 (85) 9145-3111. Our team is available to help with any questions about the system.
FAQ_7_Q: Can I use the system on multiple devices?
FAQ_7_A: Yes! The system is fully responsive and works on computers, tablets, and mobile phones. Just log in with your email and password on any browser.
FAQ_8_A: Yes. All data is stored with encryption and we never share your information with third parties. Payments are processed by Stripe, one of the most secure payment platforms in the world.
